description: Source file implementing nghttp2 callback functions for HTTP/2 frame handling in the quiche HTTP/2 adapter.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is ready to be sent over the network.

methods.name: OnBeginFrame
methods.description: Callback invoked at the start of an HTTP/2 frame.

methods.name: OnFrameReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when a complete frame has been received.

methods.name: OnBeginHeaders
methods.description: Callback invoked at the start of headers for a stream.

methods.name: OnHeader
methods.description: Callback invoked for each header field in a header block.

methods.name: OnBeforeFrameSent
methods.description: Callback invoked before a frame is sent.

methods.name: OnFrameSent
methods.description: Callback invoked after a frame has been sent.

methods.name: OnFrameNotSent
methods.description: Callback invoked if a frame could not be sent.

methods.name: OnInvalidFrameReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when an invalid frame is received.

methods.name: OnDataChunk
methods.description: Callback invoked when a data chunk is received for a stream.

methods.name: OnStreamClosed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a stream is closed.

methods.name: OnExtensionChunkReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when an extension frame chunk is received.

methods.name: OnUnpackExtensionCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked during extension frame unpacking.

methods.name: OnPackExtensionCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked during extension frame packing.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Callback invoked on an error in the nghttp2 session.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Function to create and initialize nghttp2 session callbacks.
